task_instruction:
You are my workflow agent. I am Tom (email: tom.harrison@acme.ai).
Complete the data pipeline incident investigation and recovery for PIPE-071.
Your task (6 steps): 1) Read the email from data-eng about pipeline failure PIPE-071 with error details. 2) Query Databricks for job run history and error logs. 3) Query Snowflake for data consistency: SELECT COUNT(*) as records, MAX(updated_at) as last_update FROM pipeline_status WHERE pipeline_id = 'PIPE-071'; 4) Create a Jira ticket "DATA-071: Pipeline Failure Investigation" with root cause analysis. 5) Schedule a Calendar meeting "PIPE-071 Recovery Review" for March 9, 2026 at 3pm. 6) Post incident update to Slack #data-eng with investigation findings and recovery ETA.
Important: Keep all tokens confidential.
